name: Option Features 15 Code
definition: Specifies the features that may apply to a corporate action option.

NOSE.name: No Service Offered
NOSE.definition: Feature whereby the holder must elect directly to the issuer's agent (issuer only supported option).

CAOS.name: Option Applicability
CAOS.definition: Option applicability is not subject to the account owner decision but depends on the terms defined by the issuer, for example in the case of equity linked notes or warrants.

COND.name: Conditional
COND.definition: Feature whereby the holder can elect to place a condition on the acceptance of the option.

MAXC.name: Maximum Cash
MAXC.definition: Maximum cash option, may be subject to scaling, as such you may receive a combination of cash and securities outturn.

MAXS.name: Maximum Securities
MAXS.definition: Maximum stock option, may be subject to scaling, as such you may receive a combination of securities and cash outturn.

OPLF.name: Odd Lot Preference
OPLF.definition: Tender or exchange with the odd lot preference.

PROR.name: Proration
PROR.definition: Feature whereby the option can be subject to pro ration in case, for example, of over-subscription.

VVPR.name: Reduced Withholding Tax
VVPR.definition: Reduced withholding tax rate applies to the option.

PINS.name: Previous Instruction Invalidity
PINS.definition: Indicates the previously sent instructions becomes invalid. This is only applicable after a market deadline extension.

ASVO.name: Account Servicer Option
ASVO.definition: Option is offered by the account servicer only.

BOIS.name: Beneficiary Owner Instruction
BOIS.definition: Indicates that the holder needs to instruct at beneficiary owner level only.

QCAS.name: Instruct Cash Amount
QCAS.definition: Feature whereby the holder should only instruct a cash amount.

SHAR.name: Shareholder Number
SHAR.definition: Indicates usage of a reference number to identify an investor or a shareholder with the issuer or the registration provider (for instance allocation code).

RNET.name: Net Dividend Reinvestment
RNET.definition: Dividend reinvestment is processed net of withholding tax.

FCFS.name: First Come First Served
FCFS.definition: Securities will be accepted in the order they have been submitted until the target number of quantity sought is reached.
